description: WumboLabs Labs publication registry. Single durable index mapping each published MODEL-EVIDENCE EVENT to its stable identities (model_id, profile_id, event_id), its canonical public evidence, and its publication state. The generated site is MODEL-oriented (one Labs page per model_id); this registry stays EVENT/export-oriented. The website is a derivative of canonical public evidence, never a second source of model facts. See docs/labs-publication-workflow.md.
version_2_note: v2 (2026-09-12, model/profile/event publication-identity milestone). Contract: one model_id = one canonical Labs page; one profile_id = one canonical public eval repository; one event_id = one dated Records entry. Records entries describe EVIDENCE EVENTS (records[] was per-page in v1). slug is retained per event as the unique registry key (historical v1 slugs kept, including superseded event-style slugs, for campaign-registry continuity). legacy_urls lists superseded public Labs URLs for which sync generates compatibility redirects to the model page event anchor. canonical_evidence may carry original_repo/original_commit when evidence was migrated to a canonical profile repository; migrated evidence is byte-identical (MIGRATION.md in each new repository).
generated_records_note: Entries with authoring=generated are rendered by scripts/sync_labs.py from a website-publication.json export (schema wumbolabs-labs-publication/1). source.file is a relative filename resolved against the --local-exports directory passed to the sync command at runtime; the registry deliberately contains no machine-local absolute paths. source.sha256 pins the exact export bytes consumed; sync fails if the file no longer matches. When canonical evidence is published, the entry uses source.kind=github-raw with repo/ref/path and publication_state=published.
hand_authored_records_note: Entries with authoring=hand-authored have no machine-readable export; their event body lives in data/<event_body> (moved verbatim from the pre-v2 per-event Labs pages) and sync verifies presence and identity without rewriting it.
profiles_note: Profile identity (profile_id -> canonical repository, runtime family, artifact, status) is declared canonically in each eval repository's profile.json (schema wumbolabs-eval-profile/1) and mirrored in the registry only as display/routing metadata (profile_name, profile_status, profile_repo) on each event entry.
